# Shorecrest Digital

> Shorecrest Digital builds client acquisition systems for Enrolled Agents, tax firms, CPA firms and accounting firms across the United States and Canada, including firms handling IRS and CRA work: Google Ads, Facebook Ads, landing pages, lead screening and follow-up. Founded by Shaun Kaushal (ex-Intuit).

## Products

- [Services overview](https://shorecrest.co/services): The systems compared by firm size, who runs it and ad channels.
- [LeadFirm AI, Starter Phase ($50K+)](https://shorecrest.co/services/starter): For firms that run their own marketing. Google and Facebook ads, landing pages, automated email and SMS follow-up, CRM and live support.
- [ClientSurge, Growth Phase ($250K+)](https://shorecrest.co/services/growth): Done-for-you Google and Facebook ads with every lead screened by survey and a real conversation. 10+ qualified consultations a month.

## Marketing services

- [Google Ads for accounting firms](https://shorecrest.co/services/google-ads): Google Search, Local Service Ads and Google Business Profile campaigns.
- [Facebook Ads for accounting firms](https://shorecrest.co/services/facebook-ads): Facebook and Instagram ads with every lead screened.
- [SEO, GEO & AEO for accounting firms](https://shorecrest.co/services/seo-geo-aeo): Rank on Google and get recommended by AI search tools.
